definition.source:
def experiment(inputs):
    import random
    cases = inputs.get('cases_per_seed', 4)
    length = inputs.get('length', 8)
    magnitude = inputs.get('magnitude', 100)
    seeds = inputs.get('seeds', [42])
    trials = []
    for seed in seeds:
        rng = random.Random(seed)
        for i in range(cases):
            vals = [rng.randint(1, magnitude) for _ in range(length)]
            sorted_vals = sorted(vals)
            trials.append({'id': f'trial-{seed}-{i}', 'values': sorted_vals})
    return {'trials': trials}
